summary: Cellyan Biotechnology filed a 6-K reporting results of its September 21, 2026 extraordinary general meeting held in Shenzhen, where holders of 3,395,958 Class A and 7,150,000 Class B shares representing roughly 90.29% of 399,667,457 eligible votes constituted a quorum. Shareholders approved a 1-for-20 share consolidation of both classes, reducing par value US$0.001 to US$0.02, and adopted a fifth amended memorandum and articles. This is a routine capital-structure housekeeping matter, not a special situation; the consolidation is Nasdaq-conditional with fractional shares rounded up, so watch for the effective date and any reverse-split-related trading or compliance effects.
